name: Game Tsukuttemasu.
source:
Main character likes playing games, so he starts creating games. Working with colleagues is interesting and difficult. He needs to learn to think as a leader and direct other members to reach master-up together.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-april-2006-tenshitsuki-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公喜欢玩游戏，于是开始制作游戏。与伙伴共同工作既有趣又困难。他必须学会以领导者的方式思考，带领成员一起完成开发。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-april-2006-tenshitsuki-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
